messages:
alex_marketing: Quick sprint 1 we need a 1-page battlecard + 3 sharp SDR counter-plays vs cloud-managed endpoints and API-only vendors. Keep language legal-safe and engineer-friendly.
sara_sales: I'll throw two quick counter-plays: 
- 'Predictable p99 under load' (ops-focused)
- 'Lower billed tokens via smart caching' (econ-focused)
Also need one short qualification question for inbound forms.
mike_product: Pocket battlecard axes: Economics | Latency Guarantees | Deployment & Security. Under Redwood: one-liners like 'transparent unit costs', 'p99 SLOs + fallbacks', 'VPC/on-prem, KMS'. For competitors use neutral tradeoffs, not names.
tina_growth: Webinar angle idea: 'Reproducible benchmarks for inference: how we measure, what matters.' Include a short live demo toggling batch size and showing cost vs latency. Registration poll: Cost | Latency | Compliance to route leads.
ella_legal: Reminder: swap absolutes for 'help', 'reduce', 'up to'. No competitor product names. Anonymize customer anecdotes; get sign-off for any numbers.
sara_sales: SDR counter-plays (3 variants) 
1) Quick note for devs: 'Hi {{name}}  curious if your p99 latency scales at peak. We run a single runtime you can run in your cloud or ours. 10 min to compare?'
2) For procurement: 'We offer reserved capacity, SLAs, and flexible commitment tiers. Interested in commercial terms?'
3) For platform leads: 'Avoid per-team endpoint sprawl  single runtime + private deploys. 10 min?'
field_bot: latest pocket template: https://internal.redwood/field/pocket-new (updated 2149980000)
mike_product: Quick objection scripts (one-liners): 
- Security: 'VPC, KMS/HSM, and audit logs supported.'
- Integration: 'Same API surface + SDKs and migration examples.'
- Cost: 'We help model per-token economics and provide pilot runs to validate savings.'
tina_growth: For A/B on landing: Headline A (infra): 'Serving-first inference: predictable latency at scale' Headline B (econ): 'Predictable inference costs for production apps' Route by form pick. Track SQL conversion by cohort.
alex_marketing: Action items: 
- @mike_product: drop the 3 one-liners into the shared matrix by EOD
- @sara_sales: finalize SDR scripts + inbound qualifier by EOD
- @tina_growth: set up poll and A/B config by tomorrow AM
- @ella_legal: legal pass on final copy before publish
I'll assemble a one-page PDF and email template for inbound routing. Thanks everyone :rocket:
